result.quote: So the commander dismissed the young man and instructed him, “Do not tell anyone that you have reported this to me.”
result.reason: The key is supported by verses 23–24, where the commander arranges an armed escort to take Paul safely to Felix. However, the broad question permits another distinct response: he told the young man to keep the report secret. Also, “captain” needs an article, and “the plan” has no clear antecedent within the window.
